name: Garry Chiao
headline: Full-Stack Engineer
summary: Full-stack engineer with 8+ years of software development experience across web applications, SaaS platforms, system integration, and blockchain-related solutions. Experienced in the full delivery cycle from requirements analysis and system design to implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization, with hands-on work in AI products, customized client systems, and large-scale CRM operations support.

bullets: Collaborate with project managers and design teams to turn requirements and mockups into production-grade web applications.
Own front-end and back-end feature development, system integration, and API connectivity for scalable and maintainable systems.
Handle deployments, production operations, and technical troubleshooting to keep projects stable in real-world use.
Continuously improve performance, responsive behavior, and overall user experience through iterative delivery.
Co-founded Full Stack Artisan and built Jobbly, an AI resume optimization product that helps job seekers improve application quality and efficiency.
Led product planning, system architecture, and core implementation using a JavaScript-based stack for a Chrome Extension and related cloud services.
Built and led a six-person cross-functional team covering product delivery, execution, and client-facing work.
Delivered web development, system integration, and SaaS solutions for clients from analysis through deployment and maintenance.
Built and managed email marketing campaigns on Salesforce, including audience segmentation, delivery flows, and A/B testing.
Worked with marketing, content, and operations teams to translate campaign goals into executable digital workflows.
Tracked email and website performance with Salesforce and Google Analytics to support optimization decisions.
Maintained campaign and fundraising pages while validating tracking quality and conversion measurement.
Developed Node.js backend systems, database structures, and API architecture for blockchain and fintech-related products.
Built and maintained RESTful APIs for front-end applications and third-party integrations.
Integrated cryptocurrency exchange APIs for market data ingestion, synchronization, and automated processing pipelines.
Contributed to blockchain application development including smart contracts, digital asset workflows, and business logic.
